RIKKU-GODHAND.description:
Gain 2 Potion slots. 
[gold]Mix[/gold] deal 25% more damage. 
The first time you [gold]Steal[/gold] each combat, procure 2 random [gold]Mixable Potions[/gold].
RIKKU-GODHAND.flavor: More pockets, bigger boom. What's not to love?
RIKKU-GODHAND.title: Godhand
RIKKU-CLAW.description: The first time you [gold]Steal[/gold] in a combat, procure a random [gold]Mixable Potion[/gold]. [gold]Overkill[/gold] enemies to gain better rewards.
RIKKU-CLAW.title: Claw
RIKKU-THIEFS_GLOVES.flavor: A little extra gil never hurt anybody!
RIKKU-THIEFS_GLOVES.title: Thief's Gloves
RIKKU-CHEMIST_GLOVES.description: The first [gold]Potion[/gold] you use each combat is not consumed.
RIKKU-CHEMIST_GLOVES.flavor: Always save a little something for later!
RIKKU-CHEMIST_GLOVES.title: Chemist Gloves
RIKKU-GOLDEN_HAND.description: At the start of combat, procure a random [gold]Mixable Potion[/gold].
RIKKU-GOLDEN_HAND.title: Golden Hand
RIKKU-THIEF_BANDANA.description: At the end of combat, gain an additional Potion reward if you took no damage.
RIKKU-THIEF_BANDANA.flavor: Can't catch what you can't hit!
RIKKU-THIEF_BANDANA.title: Thief Bandana
RIKKU-NINJA_CLAW.title: Ninja Claw
RIKKU-SURVIVOR.description: At the start of combat, gain 20 [gold]Overdrive[/gold].
RIKKU-SURVIVOR.flavor: Always ready for whatever comes next.
RIKKU-SURVIVOR.title: Survivor
RIKKU-ITEM_POUCH.flavor: There's always room for a few more goodies!
RIKKU-ITEM_POUCH.title: Item Pouch
RIKKU-AL_BHED_GOGGLES.flavor: Everything looks more explosive through these!
RIKKU-AL_BHED_GOGGLES.title: Al-Bhed Goggles
